dedupe_keys.name: metis multisector data harmonization and analysis

description: Metis is an R tool from the Joint Global Change Research Institute for combining water, energy, land and socioeconomic information across spatial scales. It aggregates gridded model output to user-defined boundaries and examines cross-sector relationships with input-output methods. Default material derives from GCAM and related downscaling tools, while users may substitute regional data. Geographic extent and temporal resolution therefore follow the selected grids, boundaries and scenarios. The package can help prepare regional infrastructure-demand studies and compare changes across sectors. Code access is free under the repository licence labelled BSD2-Clause, whose text also includes naming and citation conditions. A limitation is that default global-model data are a starting point for local work, not verified local measurements; statistical linkages do not establish causal infrastructure dependencies. This JGCRI tool is distinct from the European METIS energy model and the METIS graph library. It complements integrated assessment outputs. No R installation, aggregation or scenario analysis was performed.
